options.name: pageCount
options.description: Number of pages. Provide either pageCount or total.

options.name: total
options.description: Total items; the page count is derived from pageSize. Enables the summary.

options.name: pageSize
options.description: Items per page. Required with total unless pageSizes is set (then defaults to its first entry).

options.name: pageSizes
options.description: Render a native 'Rows per page' select with these sizes.

options.name: icons
options.type: Partial<{ previous: IconRef; next: IconRef; first: IconRef; last: IconRef }>

options.name: siblingCount
options.description: Pages shown on each side of the current page (0 to 10).

options.name: boundaryCount
options.description: Pages always shown at the start and end (0 to 10).

options.name: showSummary
options.description: Show 'Showing 11-20 of 57' when total is known.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

properties.name: page
properties.description: Current page (1 when there are no pages).

properties.name: pageCount
properties.description: Number of pages (given or derived from total and pageSize).

properties.name: pageSize
properties.description: Items per page, or null when only pageCount is known.

methods.name: setPage
methods.description: Go to a page programmatically (clamped; no events, no announcement).

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options. Passing pageCount drops total and vice versa.

methods.name: getPageItems
methods.signature: getPageItems(page: number, pageCount: number, siblingCount?: number, boundaryCount?: number): (number | 'ellipsis')[]
methods.description: Pure helper (module export): the page numbers and ellipses to render.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: The user changed the page or the page size.

cssClasses.name: aui-pagination__page
cssClasses.description: A page button; [aria-current=page] for the current one.

cssClasses.name: aui-pagination__compact
cssClasses.description: 'Page 3 of 10' text shown in narrow containers.
